name: desire for social influence
description: Wanting to have an effect on how others behave or perceive the world so they are more aligned with your preferences.
perceptions: There's something I'd like others to do or know about.
I'll benefit from getting them to do or know about this.
results: You may be able to get people to help you or at least stop working against you. Or you might not.

variations.name: desire to persuade others
variations.description: Trying to convince others to change a belief.
perceptions: Others don't perceive things the way I think they should.
I think I can convince them to adopt more of my perspective.

guidance.description: Here are some references for persuading people.
Changing people's minds on certain topics is not an easy task.

variations.name: desire to control others
variations.description: Being ready to threaten someone else's agency with negative consequences in order to get them to behave the way you want.
perceptions: Others are not behaving the way I think they should.
They won't respond to a nice approach.
There should be consequences for them not following my guidance.

guidance.description: Here are parenting and workplace guides to help think about reasonable consequences for guiding people you're in charge of.
The desire for control may be rooted in a fear of uncertainty.

variations.name: desire for justice
variations.description: Desire to convince others to obtain an outcome that is perceived to be aligned with important rules.
perceptions: A person or group is going to influence the outcome of an event.
I want them to abide by important rules for making this decision.
examples: Wanting a court case to go a certain way.

comparisons.description: Pushing for 'justice' is trying to persuade someone that your perspective is aligned with the rules or the 'right thing to do.'

variations.name: desire for trade
variations.description: Wanting to exchange items, activities, or information of value with another person or group.
perceptions: Someone else has something that I'd like to have.
I have something they might like.
Attacking them to get it won't help or is a bad idea.

guidance.description: Negotiation is a fundamental skill that plays a crucial role in both personal and professional life. Whether you’re negotiating a job offer, securing a contract, or resolving conflicts, strong negotiation skills can help you reach a beneficial agreement.

commentaries.quote: If you would persuade, you must appeal to interest rather than intellect.
Compelling reason will never convince blinding emotion.
I would rather try to persuade a man to go along, because once I have persuaded him, he will stick. If I scare him, he will stay just as long as he is scared, and then he is gone.
No act of kindness, no matter how small, is ever wasted.
commentaries.attribution: Aesop’s fable of The Lion and the Mouse

commentaries.quote: The key to successful leadership today is influence, not authority.
When marketers influence habits, they influence peoples' self-identity. And so when a group or company does something that doesn't correspond to our core values, it feels like a betrayal.
Anti-social behavior is a trait of intelligence in a world full of conformists.

People are prosocial creatures. We typically form enduring bonds with others. We find spending time with our family and friends rewarding, we rejoice in their good fortune, we want to help them and often go to a substantial degree of bother for others. This applies particularly in relation to people whom we consider to be part of our ‘in group’, but also often in relation to strangers.
